Sample Clip Page

This fixture exercises the zkfy web clipper end to end. It has to carry well over two hundred characters of visible prose so that the blocked-page heuristic in the Playwright fetcher does not misfire on it, and so that defuddle's content scorer treats the article element as the main content of the document rather than falling back to the body.
